mode: Read-only static/source review. No model construction, weights loaded, decoder execution, imports of this script, tracked changes, or Git writes.

checks.fixed_input: Reference PNG SHA is checked; RGB and 256x144 enforced; normalization to [-1,1] is deterministic.
checks.assets: Manifest identity verifies VAE config, safetensors and model license before creating output. local_files_only prevents checkpoint download.
checks.latent: posterior.mode() -> repeat 14 frames -> multiply fixed scale 0.18215; shape [1,14,4,18,32] and equal frames enforced; no augmentation or latent sampling.
checks.cross_process_input: Each run constructs the same deterministic inputs and writes raw-array hashes. Comparing normalized_input, latent_mode, video_latents hashes across all three completed runs remains a required result-level validation.
checks.upstream_call: Installed StableVideoDiffusionPipeline.decode_latents is called directly. Its body only needs self.vae; SimpleNamespace supplies it. It divides the scaled input by the same scaling factor.
checks.hook: Temporal decoder forward_pre_hook receives true keyword num_frames and shape. Expected calls are [14], [7,7], or 14 copies of 1. Hook removal is protected by finally.
checks.output: Raw decoder B,C,F,H,W shape [1,3,14,144,256] and all finite verified. No video postprocessing; NPY float32 values, dtype, shape, file and array-byte SHA are retained.
checks.rms: np.diff(axis=2) and mean over axes (0,1,3,4) yield one adjacent-frame raw RMS per pair. float64 arithmetic prevents float32 accumulation overflow.
checks.timing: Imports/component load, encode+latent construction, upstream decode, and serialization/diagnostics/source hashing have separate perf_counter intervals. decode includes prehook overhead.
checks.rss: resource.RUSAGE_SELF ru_maxrss is process-lifetime peak in KiB on this Linux environment, queried before final JSON write/printing/exit. It is not decode-only memory.
checks.output_protection: Existing output path or symlink rejected; mkdir(exist_ok=False) claims a fresh directory before any artifact write. Failure may leave a partial new directory for diagnosis.
checks.scope: Static repeated-frame reconstruction latent isolates temporal decoding. Scope correctly excludes U-Net, denoising, CLIP, stochastic video generation and generated-video quality.
checks.independent_peer: rotation_check independently confirmed latent construction, upstream dependency use, hook calls, shapes, RMS and saved hashes.

outer_protocol_requirements.sequence: Run chunk14 first. Continue chunk7 then chunk1 only after successful first output, wall/RSS gate and remaining-budget checks.
outer_protocol_requirements.enforcement_location: External orchestrator/run_record; this script contains no timeout, budget or RSS limit enforcement.
outer_protocol_requirements.failure_record: Outer run_record should retain timeout/exit status and command log when this script cannot reach metrics writing.
outer_protocol_requirements.comparison_gate: Require normalized_input, latent_mode and video_latents array_bytes_sha256 equality across runs before attributing decoded differences to chunk size.
